title: Embedding calibration and canary corpus harness for reranker accuracy & latency
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build a repeatable evaluation harness that combines a privacy-safe canary corpus (stratified by domain and length) with calibration tests to measure embedding accuracy, reranker NDCG/MRR, and latency/throughput under production batching and KV-cache warmup scenarios. Output must drive nightly regression alerts and be usable by model-onboarding and runtime teams.
acceptance_criteria: Canary corpus assembled with at least 6 domains and 3 length buckets; stored as versioned artifacts
Weekly offline job produces baseline metrics: Cosine calibration error, MRR@10, NDCG@5, recall@100 and p50/p95/p99 token-generation latency for embedding+rerank flows
Diff alerts (signal-to-baseline) trigger when calibration error increases by >8% or NDCG@5 drops >3% on two consecutive runs
Harness simulates realistic batching and KV-cache warmup; documented config to run at small/medium/large batch profiles
Integrations exist for telemetry export (Datadog/Prometheus), PR gating link in GitHub, and a dashboard URL
Runbook for triage created and linked in Confluence
tasks: Define canary corpus selection policy and privacy filter (prod query opt-in / synthetic augmentation)
Implement stratified sampler and store artifacts in s3 with versioned keys
Instrument evaluation runner to call embedding endpoint and reranker pipeline with configurable batching/quantization settings
Add metrics: cosine calibration (calibration curve + ECE), MRR/NDCG/recall, latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), throughput
Wire nightly job into existing CI runner and ensure result retention for 90 days
Create alert thresholds and implement automatic regressions slack/webhook notification
Document runbook and onboarding steps for model-onboarding team
comments: 2025-01-20 - Aisha Khan: Created initial ticket after spike with research on calibration metrics. Proposal: focus on calibration error + NDCG as primary signals.
2025-01-27 - Marco Rivera: POC runner implemented calling embeddings-v2 + rerank-v1 locally. Observed ~4% NDCG variance between quantized vs fp16 builds on small corpus.
2025-01-30 - Design review (noted by Lina Chen): Recommend adding user-facing example sets for observability dashboard and a simple explanation of calibration drift for PMs.
2025-02-03 - Marco Rivera: Ran full canary across three batch profiles. Latency p95 increased by 18% when forcing 8x batching without KV warmup; added KV-warmup step to runner.
2025-02-08 - Ops (Jamal Ortiz): Confirmed Datadog metric name conventions and retention; created dashboard skeleton https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/EmbCalib/embedding-calibration
2025-02-11 - Aisha Khan: Drafted alert policy: Calibration ECE increase >8% OR NDCG@5 drop >3% on two runs => P1 investigation. Added to acceptance criteria.
notes: We intentionally separate calibration measures (ECE / reliability diagrams) from absolute retrieval metrics so that we can detect systematic score scaling issues independent of ranking changes.
Corpus construction: prefer anonymized, sampled production queries (opt-in) augmented with synthetic distractors to stress reranker edge-cases.
We will publish a lightweight 'canary run' CLI for on-demand checks by SRE and model-onboarding teams.
Follow-up: if drift alerts occur, run pairwise A/B against last stable model and produce a short report for PM/Research summarizing failing query slices by domain and length.
Privacy: all stored canary artifacts will be reviewed by privacy team and scrubbed for PII before being used in nightly jobs.
